standard-dialogue.npc: Welcome! I'm Ali, and this is my tea shop! Is there anything I can do for you today?

standard-dialogue.player: Hmm... Could I get some tea?

standard-dialogue.npc: Of course! I'll get the water boiling at once. Is there anything else I can do for you while you wait?

steps.npc: Oh! Yes, the water is boiling. Just give me a minute!
I know, the desert is forever hot. Thirsty work here!

options.text: How's business here? Seems quite out the way.

steps.player: How's business here? Seems quite out the way.

steps.npc: It's not that. It's just that I've been having issues with a few thieves lately. Four to be precise!
There have been a few break-ins. A recent shipment from Karamja has been taken! That was some of the finest stuff I've ever managed to get my hands on.

steps.player: That's awful. If I see any shifty characters, I'll be sure to teach them a lesson.

steps.npc: Ha! Very courageous, adventurer! These thieves are big and brutish. I wouldn't start something you may not be able to finish.

steps.player: I'm pretty tough. I think I can handle them.

steps.npc: You're leaving? But the tea is almost done!

steps.player: I've been waiting quite a while. Perhaps another time.

standard-dialogue-subsequent-dialogue.npc: Welcome! I'm Ali, and this is my tea shop! Is there anything I can do for you today?

standard-dialogue-subsequent-dialogue.player: Well you never actually made me that tea...

standard-dialogue-subsequent-dialogue.npc: Ah yes! I'll get the water boiling at once. Is there anything else I can do for you while you wait?

options.text: How's business here? Seems quite out the way.
